subject: CodeRabbit round-1 findings on scripts/verify-dshgo-standard.ts (C5 pin checker)

major.finding: The published verify:dshgo command reported two pin-site-missing errors and exited 1 because package.json files ships scripts/ but not .github.
fix: PinReading.absent tells an absent FILE apart from a present file that states no pin.
isCheckout(root) = existsSync(<root>/.git), so a directory (clone) and a file (worktree) both count as a checkout.
auditPin(readings, checkout): absent + checkout -> pin-site-missing ERROR; absent + packaged -> pin-site-skipped NOTE; present but no 40-hex commit -> pin-site-missing ERROR in both modes.
The PIN line prints '<n> of <total> site readings agree on <sha>' and '(<n> skipped: not shipped)' when any site was skipped.

packaged.shape: npm pack tarball (mpd-dsh-mpd-0.18.0.tgz: 1262 files, 11954415 bytes, zero package/.github entries) extracted to a temp dir; no .git
packaged.pinLine: [dshgo-standard] PIN: PASS — 6 of 8 site readings agree on f36bf91b0736e81ef40c2a7040b2ec337ca1ab40 (2 skipped: not shipped)
notes: [note] pin-site-skipped .github/workflows/publish.yml — publish.yml: the file is not shipped in a packaged tree (no `.git`), so its pin cannot be read here
[note] pin-site-skipped .github/workflows/gates.yml — gates.yml: the file is not shipped in a packaged tree (no `.git`), so its pin cannot be read here

checkoutMissingWorkflow.finding: [error] pin-site-missing .github/workflows/gates.yml — gates.yml: the file is absent from this checkout — a deleted or renamed pin site must fail, not silently shrink the audit

packagedPresentButNoPin.shape: packaged tree with the sha in docs/dsh-go-standard.md rewritten to deadbeef; no .git
packagedPresentButNoPin.finding: [error] pin-site-missing docs/dsh-go-standard.md — docs/dsh-go-standard.md states no dsh-Go commit literal; every present pin site must state the same peeled release commit

trivial.finding: The C5 disagreement arm never asserted the unperturbed fixture set was clean, so a drifted fixture or selector could make it pass for the wrong reason.
trivial.fix: The arm now asserts (1) the unperturbed fixture set yields zero findings, (2) the perturbation yields EXACTLY ONE pin-disagreement, and (3) that finding names the perturbed site. Any violation throws and fails the arm.
mutationTests: A: baseline built from a perturbed fixture -> FAIL 'the unperturbed fixture set must be clean, got pin-disagreement:error' (exit 1)
B: two sites perturbed -> FAIL 'the perturbation must produce exactly one pin-disagreement, got 2' (exit 1)
C: a different site perturbed than the asserted one -> FAIL 'the disagreement must name docs/dsh-go-standard.md, got docs/dsh-go-standard.zh-CN.md states ...' (exit 1)

commands.result: SELF-TEST PASS — 46 arms (1 clean control + 45 negative controls)
PIN: PASS — 8 of 8 site readings agree on f36bf91b0736e81ef40c2a7040b2ec337ca1ab40; RESULT: LEGAL
RESULT: NOT-PASSED — the official cross-check did not run

bounds: The mode proofs run a COPY of the script from each temp root, because REPO_ROOT derives from the script's own location; the real working tree was never mutated (.git check and workflow deletions happened only in temp copies).
A .git FILE (worktree) is accepted by the same existsSync check but was exercised only with a .git DIRECTORY.
The packaged proof packs with npm pack (the package.json files allowlist); it does not run the full one-command install.
No self-test arm covers the packaged/checkout split: the count stays 46 by instruction, and the split is proven by the three end-to-end mode proofs above.
This work is uncommitted on fix/dshgo-1.0.14-repin; the captain makes the follow-up commit.
